list_tests: list available googletest-style tests by running the script with --gtest_list_tests argument
run_passing_test: run a passing googletest subTest by filtering with --gtest_filter=FirstTest.subTestA
run_slow_test: run a slow googletest subTest that sleeps for 6 seconds with --gtest_filter=FirstTest.subTestB
run_hanging_test: run a googletest subTest that hangs indefinitely with --gtest_filter=FirstTest.subTestC
validate_arguments: validate that the script requires exactly one argument and rejects unexpected inputs
